authorization_text: Add exploratory maps; keep the strict PDF results pending
question_accepted: To add calculated maps now, should I include a clearly labeled exploratory version using the former app’s bounding-box midpoints and detected-object footprints? These cannot establish full tissue coverage, so they would not meet the PDF’s strict mask requirement.
scope: Calculated exploratory aligned raw-count differences and observed-object support maps for the selected twelve completed sections.

scientific_constraints.position_definition: Bounding-box midpoint: x=(XMin+XMax)/2, y=(YMin+YMax)/2; reconstructed proxy, not measured centroid.
scientific_constraints.support_definition: Observed all-object occupancy per aligned bin, including PLA and ChAT; never interpreted as full-bin tissue coverage.
scientific_constraints.alignment: Apply saved fixed matrices unchanged; no fitting
